AIToolbox · assistant · conversation, history, tools · spec Assistant: conversation, history and tools What happens inside the assistant panel: asking, acting on messages, the tools, skills and MCP servers it may use, history, and the disclaimer. Frames are captured from the interactive prototype; the panel itself (triggers, resize, motion) is on the Assistant panel board.
0What the market doesPatterns that are now standard in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft and GitHub Copilot and Cursor, and how AIToolbox adopts them. Users arrive with these habits.
PatternSeen inWhat it isIn AIToolbox
HistoryChatGPT, Claude, GeminiConversations grouped by date, searchable, renamed and deleted from a list; titles generated from the first questionKept, inside the panel (history slides over the chat) and with Pinned on top
Edit and versionsChatGPT, ClaudeEditing a question re-runs it; the earlier version stays reachable with ‹ 1 / 2 ›Kept
RetryChatGPT, Claude, GeminiRegenerate an answer; earlier answers stay with ‹ › arrowsKept
Copy, thumbs up / downAll of themUnder every answer; thumbs down asks what went wrongKept, wired to the AIToolbox Feedback feature
StopAll of themThe send button turns into Stop while the answer is writtenKept; the partial answer stays with Retry
Tool traceClaude, ChatGPT, GitHub CopilotTools the model used shown as a collapsible list above the answerKept, with the source (AIToolbox or the MCP server)
Approval before actingGitHub Copilot agent mode, Cursor, Claude CodeActions that change something wait for a click; per-tool permissionsKept and made the rule: Always allow / Ask first / Off, write tools ask first by default
Connectors / MCPClaude, ChatGPT, Copilot, CursorAdd servers by URL, sign in with OAuth, see their toolsKept, with organisation-managed servers that users can turn off but not remove
Skills / instructionsClaude skills, Copilot instructions, custom GPTsReusable know-how loaded when relevantKept as Skills: built-in per feature, organisation, yours
DisclaimerChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, CopilotOne quiet line under the composer that the AI can be wrongKept: “The assistant can make mistakes. Check important information before you act on it.”
Context chipGitHub Copilot, CursorWhat the assistant sees from the page, removableKept: “Runs page” chip in the composer
1ConversationOne column, questions right in primary-container bubbles, answers left with the Chatbot mark, no bubble (long answers read better flush). Data in Open Sans 600, code in a copyable block.
EmptyTitle “What can I help with?”, what the assistant can do, 4 suggestions for this page. Context chip and the disclaimer under the composer.
Tools runningThe trace opens while tools run (spinner per step) and collapses to “Used 2 tools” when the answer starts. The mark types; Send is Stop.
AnswerStreamed with a caret; actions appear when it is done: Copy, Retry, thumbs up / down. Code blocks carry their own Copy.
ApprovalRun pipelines is “Ask first”: the arguments, why it asks, Run pipeline (filled) and Don’t run. Nothing runs before the click.
StreamingWords appear in small batches (35 ms); the list follows the end unless the user scrolled up (then it stays put). aria-live="polite" on the list.
Tool traceCollapsed “Used n tools” with a chevron; each step: source icon (AIToolbox tile, or the MCP server initials), label, status (spinner, check, warning). A failed or missing tool says why and links to its setting (“Datadog isn’t connected · Connect Datadog”).
Approval cardsurface-container, 1 px outline, lock icon + question as the title, arguments in Open Sans 600 on surface-container-highest, the reason (“changes something, so it asks first”), filled action + text “Don’t run”. Declining is recorded in the trace.
TitlesA new conversation is titled from its first question (40 characters); the panel header shows it, with “Conversation · Sweep › Runs”.
2Acting on messagesEvery question and answer can be copied; questions can be edited, answers retried and rated. Older versions are never lost.
Edit a questionHover → Edit: the bubble becomes a field with Cancel / Send. Enter sends, Esc cancels, ↑ in an empty composer edits the last question.
Versions‹ 2 / 2 › under the question and under the answer; switching a question version brings back the conversation that followed it.
Thumbs downReasons as chips + optional details; sent to the Feedback feature (profile “Assistant”) with the question and answer attached.
StoppedStop keeps what was written and marks “Stopped · Retry”. Running tools are marked stopped in the trace.
OnActionsRules
QuestionEdit · Copy · ‹ n / m ›Shown on hover / focus under the bubble (28 px icon buttons, on-surface-variant). Edit creates a new version; the turns after it stay with the old version.
AnswerCopy · Retry · Good · Bad · ‹ n / m ›Always visible under the last answer, on hover for older ones. Retry adds a version; Copy copies the text (code blocks have their own Copy). Good / Bad (thumb icons) are toggles; Bad opens the reason form.
While writingStopThe send button turns into Stop (on-surface fill, square icon). Esc in the composer does not stop: only the button or a new question does.
Feedback“Thanks…” snackbarReasons: Wrong or inaccurate · Not helpful · Used the wrong tool · Unsafe · Other.
3Tools, skills and MCP serversWhat the assistant may use, in two places: a quick menu in the composer (this conversation) and Assistant settings (the defaults). The admin sets the ceiling; users can only be stricter.
Composer · ToolsSwitches for tools, skills and connected servers; servers that need sign-in show Connect. The badge counts what is on.
A server not connectedThe answer says what it couldn’t check and links to Connect; the trace marks the step with a warning.
Settings · ToolsPer tool: Always allow / Ask first / Off; “Reads only” or “Changes things”.
Settings · MCP serversStatus, URL and auth, tool list (write tools in warning-container), organisation lock, add by URL with validation.
Settings · SkillsBuilt-in (one per AIToolbox feature), Organisation, Yours; Create a skill.
Rule
PermissionsReads only → Always allow by default. Changes things → Ask first by default (run, promote, create issue, merge…). Off removes the tool from the model.
MCP write toolsTools that write in another system ask first, always; they are tagged in the server card. Servers added by the organisation show a lock: can be turned off, not removed.
ConnectingOAuth opens the provider’s sign-in; API key asks for the key once (stored as a secret). The server is checked and its tools listed before it can be turned on.
Errors“Can’t reach” / “Needs sign-in” pills; the assistant never fails silently: the trace and the answer say which source was missing.
SkillsPackaged know-how (procedure, house style, feature rules) loaded only when a question needs it; shown in the trace as “Using skill: …”.
4HistoryInside the panel: the history button slides the list over the chat from the left (300 ms in, 250 ms out); Esc or the button returns to the conversation.
HistorySearch (titles and questions), Pinned, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days; the open conversation is highlighted.
Item menuRename (inline), Pin / Unpin, Delete → snackbar “Conversation deleted · Undo” for 6 s.
Settings · History and dataKeep for 30 / 90 days / 1 year (pinned kept), page context on by default, Delete all with a second confirmation.
New conversationThe header button starts a fresh one; the previous one is already in History. A conversation only enters History once a first question is sent.
PrivacyConversations are visible only to their author; admins see usage numbers, never content. Said in the history footer and the settings.
RetentionDefault 90 days, set per user within the organisation’s maximum; deletion is automatic, pinned conversations are kept.
5Disclaimer and trustSay it once, quietly, where people type; then earn trust with traces, approvals and feedback rather than warnings.
ElementSpec
Disclaimer“The assistant can make mistakes. Check important information before you act on it.” · body-small 11/15, on-surface-variant, centred under the composer, always visible, never dismissible, no icon.
SourcesEvery answer that used data shows its tool trace; names and IDs in answers are the real identifiers (Open Sans 600) so they can be checked.
ActionsAnything that changes something waits for approval unless the user chose Always allow; declining is recorded.
FeedbackThumbs on every answer feed the Feedback feature, so quality issues reach the platform team with the conversation attached.
LimitsWhen a tool is off or a server is not connected, the answer says so and links to the setting; it never guesses the missing data.
Dark themeSame structure on surface-container-low #1D1A27; answer text on-surface, question bubbles primary-container #413C8A.
6Build notesFor the front-end implementation; every behaviour above runs in the prototype.
ModelConversation { id, title, pinned, updatedAt, turns[] } · Turn { versions[], current } · Version { question, answers[], current, followingTurns[] } · Answer { text, toolCalls[], status: thinking | streaming | approval | done | stopped | denied, feedback }.
Tool calls{ source: tool id | mcp server, label, status: running | ok | warning, args, result }; approvals carry the arguments shown to the user and are re-checked against the permission when approved.
KeyboardEnter send · Shift+Enter new line · ↑ edit last question · Esc closes a menu, then History, then the panel · ⌘J toggle the panel.
AccessibilityMessage list aria-live="polite"; action buttons labelled (“Copy answer”, “Retry”, “Good answer”); approval card is a labelled group; menus are role="menu"; switches role="switch"; the settings dialog is modal with focus returned to its opener.
AngularPanel = the custom inline ait-assistant-pane (see the panel board), not a drawer; messages a virtualised list (cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport) past 100 turns; menus mat-menu; settings mat-dialog with mat-tab-group; permission mat-select; switches mat-slide-toggle; snackbar MatSnackBar with an Undo action.
